# Is your tax code right, and are you overpaying?

> Free UK tax code checker for 2026/27: decode any PAYE tax code (1257L, BR, 0T, K, M1/W1 emergency), see if your payslip tax matches it, estimate an overpayment, and work out what your code should be. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## What it models

- Cumulative and week 1 / month 1 tax to date on the 2026/27 England/Wales/NI and Scottish bands, flat codes (BR, D0, D1, Scottish SD codes), 0T, NT and K codes.
- K codes are capped at 50% of pay (the overriding limit), so a payslip held at half its pay is not flagged as a payroll error.
- The code builder gives no M or N code above the basic-rate limit (Scotland: the intermediate-rate limit), since a higher-rate taxpayer can neither give nor receive Marriage Allowance.
